substack.email_subject: The glow came first. The number took four years.
substack.note:
At night, Marie and Pierre Curie sometimes walked back out to the shed just to watch their test tubes glow. For months, that faint blue-green light was the only evidence anything was there at all.

She never called it a discovery. She called it a measurement.
